notes: This bundle does not include or alter Apps Script backend, keys, or stored private profile data.
conversationMemory: opt-in browser-local IndexedDB for Work/Leisure only; Professor and Health remain ephemeral
geminiConnection: Existing backend only. Not verified end-to-end without user-authenticated session and server configuration.
responseGeneration: LLM via onyx.chat, never direct browser Gemini secret

corpusIntegrity: Exactly 10,000 reference entries retained; 5,000 per profile.
